description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem class, which extends CustomShippingQuoteItem. It includes properties for maximum weight and price text, and provides a JSON string representation method.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuoteWeightItem
classes.description: A class representing a shipping quote item with weight and price details, supporting JSON serialization.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the price text associated with the shipping quote item.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the price text associated with the shipping quote item.

methods.name: setMaximumWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight for the shipping quote item.

methods.name: getMaximumWeight
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight for the shipping quote item.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the shipping quote item to a JSON string representation including price and maximum weight.
